set_bc.observedRole: decode current BattleStatus stream into p_party ACTION state

get_bc_asc_ridepet.behavior: delimiter-terminated ride-pet string parser into ACTION+0x1d8

firstInteger.destination: local combat participant count stored into current master ACTION +0xe0

battleFlags.downstream: death, ride/pet, jujutsu/status, reverse and fade-out handling

targetSpecificExtraFields.offset0xd1c: integer parsed from BC stream; when >0 passed to set_obj_effect(action, value)
targetSpecificExtraFields.offset0xd20: integer parsed from BC stream; when >0 passed to set_obj_effect1(action, value)

0x00000002.label: BC_DEATH cross-source
0x00000002.effect: death/forced-death setup; hp zeroing and death animation path when conditions are met

0x00000200.label: BC_FADE_OUT cross-source
0x00000200.effect: target logic marks participant as traveling/fading and moves it outside the normal battle position before raster update

0x00000400.label: BC_REVERSE cross-source
0x00000400.effect: when target ACTION+0x118 slot is inactive, invokes set_attrib_reverse(action)

singleStatusSelection.precedence: later tests overwrite earlier d3 selections; highest matching tested flag wins

statusWrite.whenSelected: call set_single_jujutsu(statusId, action), then write statusId to ACTION+0xcc

fadeOut.effect: sets travel attribute, chooses outside-screen coordinates according to group side, then set_raster_pos(action)

fresh.effect: initial participant positioning and animation setup; certain special graphic numbers use an alternate appear/stand/walk path

death.effect: when current action marker is the special appear state, converts to death state, zeros hp, updates position, plays death animation to completion, loads bitmap and triggers death-related effect setup

petOk.effect: sets a dedicated action byte flag

get_bc_num.endOfStream: NUL causes one-position rewind and return -1

crossSourceReference.status: semantic comparison only; target identity/version is not asserted

importantTargetDivergence.bcWaterFearBits: Target disassembly contains two successive tests of 0x10000000 assigning status 32 then 33. The second visible test is not 0x20000000, so do not silently rewrite it to the cross-source header's BC_FEAR bit without target evidence.

directUse: decode battle participant BC records into player/pet/enemy runtime state
apply battle status animation/state IDs 1..23, 32..34 using target-observed flag precedence
preserve target-specific extra effect fields at ACTION+0xd1c/+0xd20
notProven: human-readable names of status IDs 1..23/32..34 from target APK alone
server formulas that generate battleFlags or status transitions
exact runtime meaning of target ACTION offsets without further structure/consumer evidence
